docs.title: User guide
docs.text: Welcome to the NDVI Monitor user guide.

docs.title: Add field
docs.text:
1. Open Fields from the left menu.
  2. Click Add field.
  3. Draw the field boundary on the map.

docs.title: Adding a field
docs.text: This page explains how to add a new field.

docs.title: Add field
docs.text:
1. Open Fields from the left menu.
  2. Click Add field.
  3. Draw the field boundary on the map.
